key_points: Meta shares tumbled 11% after-hours on AI cost pressures and disappointing Q3 outlook.
European regulators threaten major fines over alleged addictive platform features.
Wells Fargo raised Meta price target citing AI product cycle potential.
Deutsche Bank estimates Meta Muse could contribute up to 8% of revenue by 2030.
Mixed insider activity: some buying (Central Pacific Bank, Eastern Bank) but also selling/trimming by Ballew Advisors, General Partner Inc.
